content.text:
I added a Sci key that opens and closes a panel with √x, x² and 1/x; these take their number the same way ± does (0 right after an operator), and their result counts as finished, so the next digit starts a new number. Keyboard entry already worked, and all five checks pass, including the new `check/sci.cjs`, so nothing earlier had broken.
Invalid results (1/0, √ of a negative) show Error, as division by zero does; history shows these as `√9`, `(-2)²` and `1/4`.
I rejected keyboard shortcuts for the scientific keys (not asked for), and I left `%` out, since batch 06 removed it on purpose.
